Hi guys! Gorsh, don't know what to really say about myself. Well like most people around here, I, at one point (well for me, it is still) frequented Reddit (and 4chan). I found this site when I was on /vg/ browsing the Grand Strategy General. Someone mentioned how Reddit is Digg 2.0 and Voat is Reddit 2.0. I wanted a refresher from the usual Reddit stuff so I explored into it and this place seems like a nice little community.

I still browse Reddit, mostly for the small friendly subs. The largest sub that I still browse regularly is /r/kerbalspaceprogram (~100k subscribers) and even I don't care much for it since it is really mundane. This place will be, however, where I will reside from now on.

However, we all know that this place will fall one day. Like Digg and like Reddit, Voat has started out as a free speech haven. It'll get to the point where either

1)Like Digg, something is removed that people really liked or added, which people hate.

2)Like Reddit, it is no longer a free speech haven.

It's inevitable, but for now this place will be nice.
Welcome to Voat my friend, hope you enjoy it here!
